items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Dick Powell sang a chorus of it, Anita louise sang a chorus of it, Louis sang a chorus of it, and I sang a chorus of it.

ctx.x: I regret to say it, I haven't heard it yet.
Well, I had it at one time, but I'm sure I don't have it now. I lost a lot of my recordings.
'It Ain't Necessarily So' -- we did that because at the time 'Porgy and Bess' was on Broadway -- the version of it was on Broadway, and so we did that.
